Message:
libbpf: Add SEC name for xdp programs attached to CPUMAP

As for DEVMAP, support SEC("xdp_cpumap/") as a short cut for loading
the program with type BPF_PROG_TYPE_XDP and expected attach type
BPF_XDP_CPUMAP.
